senses.gloss:
ITA-8.3.33 śaṣkuliḥ शष्कुलिः
Type of cake
A large round cake composed of ground rice, sugar and sesame, which is cooked in oil.

ITA-9.6.41 śastram शस्त्रम्
Sharp surgical instruments
Instruments with sharp or cutting edges used for surgical purposes.

ITA-5.76.200 śastrakarma-apacāraḥ शस्त्रकर्म-अपचारः
Condition of improper surgical intervention

ITA-9.6.2 śastrakarmayogyavaidyalakṣaṇa शस्त्रकर्मयोग्यवैद्यलक्षः
Qualities of ideal surgeon
The qualities or attributes required by the ideal surgeon.

ITA-4.2.23 śastrakṛtarogaḥ शस्त्रकृतरोगः
Diseases caused by sharp instruments
Diseases and conditions caused by weapons or instruments such as swords, surgical instruments, stones or wood.

ITA-5.76.148 śastradaṇḍahate nasya vyāpadaḥ शस्त्रदण्डहते नस्य व्यापदः
Condition due to inhalation therapy administered to person injured by sharp and blunt weapon
A condition characterized by excruciating pain.

ITA-9.6.82 śastradoṣaḥ शस्त्रदोषः
Defects of sharp instruments
The eight types of defects affecting sharp instruments which make them unsuitable for the respective surgical procedures: crooked, blunt, fissured, rough, very thick, very thin or small, too long and too small.

ITA-9.6.87 śastradhārā शस्त्रधारा
Degree of sharpness of instruments
The degree of the sharpness of instruments for various surgical procedures is as follows: instrument with a cutting edge similar to that of a single split lentil for incising or cutting, half a single split lentil for scarification or curetting, a strand of hair for puncturing and draining, and half a strand of hair for excision.

ITA-9.6.83 śastrapāyanā शस्त्रपायना
Tempering of sharp surgical instruments
There are three types of tempering for sharp instruments: with caustic liquids, water and oil

ITA-5.76.201 śastravibhramaḥ शस्त्रविभ्रमः
Condition due to faulty surgical procedure

ITA-9.6.98 śastravisrāvaṇam शस्त्रविस्रावणम्
Bloodletting with a surgical instrument
Procedures for bloodletting by making small cuts or venesection .

ITA-9.6.81 śastrasampat शस्त्रसम्पत्
Qualities of ideal sharp surgical instruments
The qualities of ideal sharp surgical instruments which make them suitable for surgical procedures are: having a good handle, made of quality metal, fine blade, excellent appearance and face well positioned.

ITA-4.8.40 śastrasādhya शस्त्रसाध्य
Conditions amenable to surgery
A disease or condition that requires, and which can be treated and managed by surgical techniques.

ITA-1.5.9 śāstraguṇāḥ शास्त्रगुणाः
Qualities of technical writing
Good technical writing following structured sets of rules or instruments such as devices for composition and analysis of technical treatises (tantrayukti), sources of meaning (arthashraya), compositions (kalpana), inclinations (tacchilya) and explanations (vyakhya). These are literary devices to assist in comprehending the technical and hidden meanings of classical texts.

ITA-2.9.1.11 ṣaṣṭamamāsa-garbhaḥ षष्ठमासगर्भः
Sixth month of pregnancy
This month is characterized by an excessive increase in foetal strength; an increase in foetal complexion; appearance of intellect; appearance of tendons; appearance of veins; appearance of body hair; appearance of nails; appearance of skin; the pregnant woman loses her strength and complexion.

ITA-5.54.13 saśalyavraṇaḥ सशल्यव्रणः
Ulcer with foreign body.
A wound characterized by a pricking sensation; numbness; heaviness; excessive sensation of being struck; oedema; severe pain; patient always protecting the affected part.

ITA-5.66.12 saśophapākaḥ सशोफपाकः
Panophthalmitis
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: itching of the eyes; rheum; associated with watering; eyes resembling ripe udumbara; burning sensation; gooseflesh-like feeling in eyes; coppery discoloration; oedema; pricking type of pain; heaviness; repeated discharge; frequent hot tear secretion; frequent cold tear secretion; swelling of eyes; inflammation/suppuration of eyes; severe pain; spitting/excessive expectoration; frequent clear tear secretion; frequent slimy tear secretion; frequent thin tear secretion; frequent thick tear secretion.
